daftar: Bara gambut menjalar di bawah permukaan, sehingga api sulit dipadamkan dari atas.
Gambut dianggap rusak bila airnya surut lebih dari {{angka:karhutla.muka_air_cm|fmt=0}} cm di bawah permukaan; saat itu gambut kering dan mudah terbakar.
Jumlah kejadian karhutla meningkat tajam bila rata-rata curah hujan selama musim kemarau di bawah {{angka:karhutla.hujan_ambang|fmt=0|satuan}}.
Kerugian 2015 sekitar US${{angka:karhutla.biaya_per_ha_2015}} per ha dari total US${{angka:karhutla.biaya_2015|fmt=1}} miliar (Bank Dunia); angka ini dasar prakiraan 2026.

kolom.isi: Gambut yang dibiarkan mengering mudah terbakar; apinya menjalar di bawah permukaan dan asapnya meluas.

daftar: Kami sangat mengapresiasi tawaran bantuan tersebut.
Untuk operasi kemanusiaan, kami menggunakan mekanisme sipil di bawah BNPB sesuai Undang-Undang Penanggulangan Bencana.
Perjanjian mengenai status pasukan merupakan kewenangan pemerintah pusat melalui Kemlu dan Kemhan, dan tidak diputuskan dalam forum kemitraan penanggulangan bencana.

slide.judul: Talking Point: Penyambutan Misi Bantuan Australia untuk Penanganan Karhutla di Kalimantan Timur {{sorot:(1/3)}}
slide.sumber: Naskah talking points Kepala BNPB, Nov 2026; Bakom 15 Okt 2026; Setkab 21 Sep 2026

kolom.isi: On behalf of the Government and people of Indonesia, I wish to convey our heartfelt appreciation to the Government and people of Australia for the timely and generous offer of assistance in response to the forest and land fires currently affecting our country. This gesture of solidarity speaks volumes about the depth of friendship, mutual trust, and good neighbourliness that has long characterised the relationship between Indonesia and Australia, particularly in times of adversity.

kolom.judul: Assistance as Support to an Indonesian-Led Response
kolom.isi: We are deeply grateful for this support, and we would like to respectfully underline that assistance from Australia, as well as from other partner countries, is most welcome as a complement to the response operations led and conducted by the Government of the Republic of Indonesia. This approach ensures coherence, accountability, and effectiveness on the ground, while allowing us to make the best possible use of the valuable contributions of our partners.
Terima kasih kepada pemerintah dan rakyat Australia atas tawaran bantuan yang cepat.
Bantuan mitra melengkapi operasi yang dipimpin pemerintah Indonesia.
Bantuan dipakai sebaik mungkin sesuai kebutuhan lapangan.

slide.judul: Talking Point: Penyambutan Misi Bantuan Australia untuk Penanganan Karhutla di Kalimantan Timur {{sorot:(2/3)}}
slide.sumber: Naskah talking points Kepala BNPB, Nov 2026; Bakom 15 Okt 2026; Setkab 21 Sep 2026

kolom.judul: BNPB as Coordinating Authority within a Single Command System
kolom.isi: In accordance with the Law on Disaster Management of 2007, operational coordination for disaster response in Indonesia rests with the National Disaster Management Authority, BNPB. Accordingly, all personnel, aircraft, equipment, and logistics from partner countries will be fully integrated into our national command system, accompanied at all times by BNPB and Indonesian National Armed Forces personnel, and will operate on the basis of flight plans and operational plans approved by BNPB and the Indonesian Air Force. This arrangement is intended to ensure safety, coordination, and the optimal use of all available resources.

We are pleased that Australian assistance will complement our ongoing national efforts, particularly in strengthening aerial water-bombing operations. To date, our helicopters have flown {{angka:karhutla.wb_sorti}} water-bombing sorties and released water {{angka:karhutla.wb_drop}} times, supported by {{angka:karhutla.omc_sorti}} weather modification sorties. These contributions will add significant value to our integrated operations, which also include ground firefighting, weather modification, and joint patrols, and will help accelerate our collective progress on the ground.
Seluruh aset mitra masuk sistem komando nasional di bawah BNPB.
Penerbangan memakai rencana yang disetujui BNPB dan TNI AU.
Bantuan memperkuat operasi udara yang sudah berjalan.

slide.judul: Talking Point: Penyambutan Misi Bantuan Australia untuk Penanganan Karhutla di Kalimantan Timur {{sorot:(3/3)}}
slide.sumber: Naskah talking points Kepala BNPB, Nov 2026; Bakom 15 Okt 2026; Setkab 21 Sep 2026

kolom.isi: I would like to share with Your Excellency the scale of Indonesia's national response. To date, the Government has mobilised {{angka:karhutla.personel_total}} joint personnel and {{angka:karhutla.setkab.pesawat}} aircraft across Sumatra, Kalimantan, and Papua, from the Armed Forces and the Police to local governments, private-sector crews, volunteers, and community fire brigades. This mobilisation reflects the full commitment of the Government of Indonesia to addressing this challenge with all available national capacities, and with the strong support of our partners. Around {{angka:karhutla.personel_nonpem_persen|fmt=1|persen}} of these personnel come from communities and the private sector, reflecting a truly whole-of-society effort.

While air quality in several affected areas has begun to show encouraging signs of improvement, we remain fully vigilant. Weekly fire detections have fallen by {{angka:fs.pekan_turun_abs|fmt=1|persen}} from their peak in early October as the rainy season begins. Fire suppression and the prevention of further spread continue to be our foremost priorities. The Government of Indonesia remains firmly committed to managing this situation in a swift, measured, and transparent manner, while placing the safety of our communities and the preservation of our national sovereignty at the centre of all our efforts.

Over the coming days, the Australian Hercules will fly {{angka:aus.sorti_hari}} sorties a day for {{angka:aus.hari}} days in East Kalimantan, working side by side with our national fleet and the Provincial Government of East Kalimantan under a single command. In closing, we express our sincere hope that this cooperation will extend well and deepen our partnership. We are confident that through continued collaboration, we can further strengthen the resilience of both our peoples and the wider region.
Pemerintah mengerahkan seluruh kapasitas nasional.
Pemadaman dan pencegahan meluasnya api tetap prioritas.
Kerja sama diharapkan memperkuat ketangguhan kawasan.
